positive_snippets: Fantastic Service by the host, very welcoming. I seriously recommend you to visit you will get ac/non ac rooms in very reasonable rates
Superb place, well maintained and awesome place for the people who are traveling to Gurgaon and wants to stay here at the cheap price.
negative_snippets:
Room service was bad.
Rooms were not fresh when we reached the hotel, and the room service guy was not well-behaved. The bedsheets and pillow cover, blanket cover were dirty, but he kept insisting it was not dirty. We had to argue with him to get it changed.

The room also lacked a window for proper ventilation, but it did have AC, which we did not use since this was in December. The washroom did not have a shower either.

They did not provide us with slippers to use in the washroom. So, if you are planning to stay here, then carry your own slippers.
Wi-Fi was good.

Location-wise it is close to SGT college, but there are problems with Uber and OLA. You have to walk a bit to get auto.

It's a normal looking lodge kind of place. Should not be called a Resort. Not too bad & not too good. Washrooms were clean and had hot water. Rooms had wifi and AC. They have inhouse kitchen from which you can order all types of food, snacks & drinks. So it's ok to stay here for a day or two, if you are in this area for some work and need a place to stay.
Worth service, team are given my room to other while I am not in day and visited my official work. Hospitality is also poor with customer, and harrased me while I am complaint about this
